title: interplains/Zero-Breach-Toolkit
why_read: An open-source, offline toolkit for detecting mercenary spyware traces across major desktop and mobile platforms is a genuinely useful security tool.
analysis: This toolkit scans devices and backups for indicators of commercial/mercenary spyware such as Pegasus-type tools, working offline across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iPhone backups. Offline operation is important for this use case since victims of targeted surveillance may not want to transmit forensic data to third-party servers. Open-sourcing such detection tools increases scrutiny and trust compared to closed commercial forensic products like those from Amnesty or Citizen Lab-adjacent efforts. This is a legitimate defensive security tool with real-world protective value for journalists, activists, and security researchers.
